include(cmake/MiniI18n.cmake)
include(cmake/MiniDWG.cmake)
option(WANLUO_BUILD_CAD_CORE "Build the editing core" OFF)
if(WANLUO_BUILD_CAD_CORE)
    set(MINICAD_WITH_SOLID OFF)
    include(cmake/MiniCAD.cmake)
    if(MSVC)
        target_compile_options(MiniCAD PRIVATE /MP4)
        target_compile_options(MiniDWG PRIVATE /MP4)
    endif()
endif()
